newsitem.title: USA: MFB to buy back shares, adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: MFB to buy back shares, adopts rights plan.

text.p: MFB Corp said its board authorized the company to repurchase an additional 93,764 shares of its common stock, equal to about five percent of its outstanding shares.
The authorization brings the total shares now available for repurchase by the company to 192,463 shares, or about 10 percent of its outstanding shares.
Repurchases may begin as early as October 11, the bank holding company said.
The company said that since it completed its conversion to a publicly owned stock company on March 24, 1994, it has repurchased 328,371 shares at an average price of $13.52 per share.
The company also said the board of directors adopted a shareholder rights plan.
"The plan is designed to enhance long term shareholder value by limiting the ability of individuals to engage in inadequate, undesirable or hostile takeover attempts," the company said.

"The plan also allows the company to carry out its strategic plan of diversification, increased market share, franchise growth and enhancement of long term shareholder value as a local, independent community bank," MFB said.
